items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You can think of my boy John Kazmaier. [INTERVIEWEE] He was a powerful man for a brass band.

ctx.x: Three flat clarinet players, I'll never hear that again. Three.
You can think of my boy John Kazmaier.
He was a powerful man for a brass band.
